title: Errors are values, not crashes
description:
As a host application (Swift, a server), I want every failure returned as a typed error, so that one bad query can't kill the process.

```gherkin
Feature: Errors are values
  Scenario: Querying an unknown index reports it
    Given a table "users" with primary key "id"
    When I query index "by_email" on "users"
    Then the result is an error of kind "UnknownIndex" naming "by_email"
    And the database still answers queries
```
